explanation: The name often used to refer to God in the Old Testament, representing his authority and power.
To express gratitude or ask for God's favor and protection for someone or something.
The immaterial and eternal part of a human being, regarded as the center of personality and emotions.
An action, thought, or attitude that breaks with God's will and moral law.
God's unconditional love and mercy given to people without them deserving it.
The quality of showing compassion and grace, especially toward those who suffer or have done wrong.
Tolerant and willing to wait for changes or improvements, even when it takes a long time.
The principle of acting rightly and in accordance with moral laws and principles.
Sympathy and forgiveness shown toward someone over whom one has power, especially God's compassion toward people.
To take away or separate; here used of God removing sin and guilt from people.
A symbol of strength and renewal, used here as a metaphor for how God renews human youthful vigor.
